test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

My son learns his lessons every day.

options.text: His lessons got learnt every day by my son.
His lessons is learnt by my son every day
His lessons do learn every day by my son.
His lessons are learnt by my son every day.

solution:
The correct answer is **"His lessons are learnt by my son every day."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice.
 
• As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V1(s/es) + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ is/am/are + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *She shows them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Some rare photographs are shown by her. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'My son'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'His lessons.'
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Learns' will be changed into 'are learnt'.
 
• The preposition** "by"** is used to indicate who is performing the action (in this case, "my son").
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct sentence:* His lessons are learnt by my son every day.*
